content: Execution Management shall support the configuration of OS resource budgets for process and groups of processes. Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: RS_SAF_10008 Description: Based on the Execution Manifest , Execution Management shall allocate OS resources to the Process . The allocation shall be possible for single Process and groups of Processes . Rationale: Real-time guarantees shall be defined Dependencies: – Use Case: Like cgroups (based on containers which contain one or more processes) and ulimit . Supporting Material: –
